customer: Caller selling his pickup asked how he gets paid and whether he still owes payments on the truck loan while the sale goes through.
agent: Customer asked about payment timing after selling his pickup, which still has a loan on it. Explained per 'When and how you get paid' that once paperwork is signed he can take a bank draft at the store, direct deposit (1 to 3 business days), or a mailed check (5 to 7 business days). Told him we send the payoff to his lender within 2 business days and he receives the amount left over. Advised him to keep making his loan payments until his lender confirms the payoff.
